127     def assert_valid_move(self, x: int, y: int) -> None:
128         """Check if the move is valid."""
129         if not (0 <= x < self.size and 0 <= y < self.size):
130             raise RuntimeError(f"Invalid move: {[x, y]} out of board range.")
131 
132         if not self.board[x, y] == EMPTY_PIECE:

136             )

138     def check_win(self, x: int, y: int, piece: str) -> bool:
139         """Check if the player wins the game."""
140         xline = self._check_line(self.board[x, :], piece)
141         yline = self._check_line(self.board[:, y], piece)
142         diag1 = self._check_line(np.diag(self.board, y - x), piece)
143         diag2 = self._check_line(
144             np.diag(np.fliplr(self.board), self.size - 1 - x - y),
145             piece,
146         )
147         return xline or yline or diag1 or diag2
148 
149     def check_draw(self) -> bool:
150         """Check if the game ends in a draw."""
151         return np.all(self.board != EMPTY_PIECE)

153     def board2text(self) -> str:
154         """Convert the board to a text representation."""
155         return "\n".join(

158                 for _ in self.board
